feature.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The <name> casts one of the following spells (spell save <dc_default>):

entries: The <name> makes two Flame Blade attacks.
{@atkr ms} <hit_default>, reach 5 ft., one target <dmg_medium> Fire damage.
{@atkr ms} <hit_default>, reach 5 ft., one target <dmg_medium> Fire damage and one additional creature the <name> chooses within 5 feet of the target takes <dmg_4s3_d8s> Fire Damage.
{@atkr mw} <hit_default>, reach 5 ft., one target <dmg_puny> slashing damage.
The <name> gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed for one minute.
Once it uses this feature, it cannot do so again for one hour.

The <name> moves up to 45 feet. It can do this movement in one straight 45-foot line or in three sequential straight 15-foot lines. This movement ignores {@variantrule Opportunity Attacks|XPHB} and can move through the space of other creatures. Each creature the <name> moves within 5 feet off must make a <dc_default> Dexterity saving throw or take <spl_dmgweak> fire damage and start {@hazard burning|XPHB}. A creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} if the <name> moved through its space. A creature takes half damage and is not burning on a success.
Once the <name> uses this feature, it cannot do so again until the end of it's next turn.
The <name> takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action. Additionally, it ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} until the end of the current turn.
